item.title: Thrive Capital led VCs into pro sports ownership; Collaborative Fund just upped that play
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Collaborative Fund just bought into D.C. United and its stadium, with firm founder Craig Shapiro pitching it as a way to showcase for the firm's startups.

item.title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Nvidia has its finger in every pie, and sees another year of plenty in its future, Jensen Huang says. But, he insists, its deals are not circular.

item.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Mark Wahlberg joins Bruce K. Lee at Disrupt to discuss investing, entrepreneurship, healthcare, wellness, and building businesses.

item.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The company said Pro subscriptions put the most strain on its systems, so it's pausing sign-ups while adding more capacity.

item.title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: A new report released Thursday by Anthropic alleges persistent distillation attacks by China-based AI companies, which have escalated in recent months as competition in the space has intensified.

item.title: Furo’s founders left Silicon Valley — and it’s paying off
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: The three 28-year-old founders behind energy startup Furo moved from Silicon Valley and back to Germany, and yet secured $4 million in funding from mostly U.S. backers.

item.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta's newest app Muse is off to a slower start than the company's other apps, like Meta AI or Threads.

item.title: Proxima Fusion bets €140M on a critical fusion ingredient dominated by Asian suppliers
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Proxima Fusion said Wednesday it plans to build a €140 million ($162.6 million) factory to produce fusion-grade high-temperature superconducting (HTS) tape, which will provide the startup with key component to its reactor design.

item.title: Amazon makes it easier to buy what you see on Prime Video
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Amazon is expanding shopping integrations across Prime Video, letting viewers discover products tied to thousands of shows, movies, and live sports through X-Ray, its shopping app, and a new Lens-powered “Shop the Scene” feature.

item.title: Anthropic reveals rogue AI agents hate CAPTCHAs, just like you
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Come inside the mind of a bot trying to convince the internet it's human.

item.title: India’s Pocket FM doubles revenue run rate to $500M as AI powers 93% of audio content
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Pocket FM uses AI to produce 99% of its new content, helping make content production about 80 times cheaper.

item.title: Instagram’s latest feature lets you add tagged posts to your profile grid
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Instagram's newest feature lets users take posts from the Tagged tab and move it to their main profile grid instead.

item.title: Google is making it easier to switch between password managers on Android
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Google's new feature will transfer your passkeys as well.

item.title: The Boring Company raises $3B in round led by UAE
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The company said it plans to dig more than 150 kilometers of tunnels in the Middle Eastern country.

item.title: AI agents are flooding public services with new requests
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: “The vast majority of cases we find are people who are entitled to claim for something, claiming for that thing,” the researcher told TechCrunch.

item.title: Bending Spoons to buy collaboration tools maker Miro for $1.36B, 90% less than its 2022 valuation
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Bending Spoons is buying Miro for $1.36 billion, a huge dip in valuation for the workplace collaboration startup, which was valued at $17.5 billion in late 2021.

item.title: Maven Robotics wants to steal your robot deployment deal
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Maven Robotics emerged from stealth today with a $100 million Series A and active deployments.

item.title: Google signs its biggest rice-methane carbon credit deal with Indian startup Mitti Labs
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The four-year agreement will cover rice farms across three Indian states, reaching about 100,000 hectares at peak delivery.

item.title: ID verification giant IDScan confirms data breach with more than 150 million driver’s licenses stolen
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The ID checking company said the data breach included people's full names and driver's licenses and other government-issued identity documents.

item.title: Snapchat takes aim at Partiful with new event-planning features
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Snapchat says the new features can be used to organize everything from birthday celebrations and sporting events to study sessions and weekend hangouts.
